selection_statements.text: The paper explicitly says the three IUGR animals were included for interest but were not analyzed in detail and were excluded from statistical comparisons. Their Table 2 rows are a separate pilot cohort, not a matched comparator for the ten extremely preterm animals.
Do not join these aggregate comparator summaries to the numbered Animal 1-10 EXTEND records; no cross-group animal-level mapping is reported.

limitations: This separate candidate contains ten Table 2 fields for three IUGR pilot animals only. It is not part of the ten-animal extremely preterm EXTEND cohort and is explicitly excluded from the paper’s statistical comparisons.
No IUGR brain mass, brain ratio, organ weight, MRI or histology result appears in the IUGR columns transcribed here; no missing outcomes are imputed from other groups.

The IUGR pilot is descriptive and not analyzed in detail in the article. Its 8–23 day support range and small-animal characteristics do not establish a validated minimum-size interface, reproducible performance, or human feasibility.
This experiment ended with euthanasia for terminal analysis and reports no post-support developmental follow-up.
